entities.summary: Josefina de la Torre Millares was a Spanish poet, novelist, and opera singer, as well as a stage, film, radio, and television actress. She was closely associated with the Generation of '27, an influential group of poets including Ernestina de Champourcín, Juan José Domenchina, Concha Méndez and Carmen Conde, that arose in Spanish literary circles between 1923 and 1927, essentially out of a shared desire to experience and work with avant-garde forms of art and poetry. Josefina de Latorre was a authors & novelists from Las Palmas de Gran Canaria (1907-09-25, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria–2002-07-12). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent figure of the Generation of '27, Josefina de Latorre contributed to the development of Spanish modernism and influenced the country's literary landscape. Her work had a moderate impact on regional artistic movements.
